picks.title: UChicago AI Researcher Rana Hanocka launches Thrixel, a 3D generation platform
picks.excerpt: UChicago researcher Rana Hanocka launches Thrixel, a 3D generation platform whose Build World workflow pairs creators with an AI coding agent to generate assets and logic for Roblox, Three.js, Unity and Unreal.
picks.rationale: New tool launch: text-to-3D plus an agent that writes game logic for Roblox/Unity/Unreal; directly usable by game artists and designers.

picks.title: How EA Javelin anti-cheat is changing in the face of AI attacks | Mike Reavey exclusive interview
picks.excerpt: EA's Mike Reavey explains how the Javelin anti-cheat system is evolving to counter AI-powered cheats such as computer-vision aimbots, and how EA uses ML on its own side of detection.
picks.rationale: Fresh angle: computer-vision aimbots vs ML detection at EA; first anti-cheat story in the 30-day history.

picks.title: Black Myth: Wukong sequel devs said no to AI because of Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey
picks.excerpt: Game Science says it will refrain from using AI on Black Myth: Zhong Kui 'until the end', citing Christopher Nolan's all-practical approach on The Odyssey as inspiration.
picks.rationale: New studio policy statement from a major AAA team (Game Science), freshest item in the pool.

picks.title: New MMO Aion 2 soars on Steam with nearly 400,000 concurrent players despite mixed reviews grilling AI slop and pay-to-win shop
picks.excerpt: NCSoft's Aion 2 hits nearly 400,000 concurrent Steam players at its global launch, but 'Mixed' user reviews call out AI-generated content alongside its monetization.
picks.rationale: Market data point: a big Korean MMO launch where AI-generated content shows up in player reviews despite strong concurrency.

picks.title: Google debuts new 'experimental' AI game platform named Google Playground
picks.excerpt: Google has announced Google Playground, a new platform for making and playing games derived from gen-AI prompts.
picks.rationale: Google's own prompt-to-game platform launch; a new first-party AI game destination, distinct from Unity Spark (editor) and Astrocade (third-party platform).
